def Roth.lam : (δ : Real) → (n m : Nat) → Real :=
fun (δ : Real) (n m : Nat) ↦
  @HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul)
    (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul)
      (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul)
        (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 4)
          (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo.{0} Real (nat_lit 4) Real.instNatCast Roth.lam._proof_1))
        (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHAdd.{0} Real Real.instAdd)
          (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 1) (@One.toOfNat1.{0} Real Real.instOne))
          (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul)
            (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 3)
              (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo.{0} Real (nat_lit 3) Real.instNatCast Roth.lam._proof_2))
            δ)))
      (@Nat.cast.{0} Real Real.instNatCast n))
    (Real.sqrt (@Nat.cast.{0} Real Real.instNatCast m))
